name: FolderBridge Engineering Methods
description: Six engineering methods for architecture, diagnosis, test-driven development, review, and implementation.

skills.name: Codebase Design
skills.description: Design deep modules with small interfaces at clean seams; use interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage, and locality precisely.

skills.name: Improve Codebase Architecture
skills.description: Survey a changing codebase for high-leverage opportunities to deepen shallow modules rather than performing style-only refactors.

skills.name: Diagnosing Bugs
skills.description: Diagnose hard bugs by first constructing a deterministic red feedback loop, then minimizing, ranking hypotheses, instrumenting, fixing, and locking a regression.

skills.name: Test-Driven Development
skills.description: Build one observable behavior at a time with a red-green-refactor loop aimed at a public interface seam.

skills.name: Code Review
skills.description: Review a bounded diff independently against repository standards and the originating spec, then rank concrete findings.

skills.name: Implement
skills.description: Execute an already-settled spec through agreed seams using TDD, regular checks, a full regression suite, and a final review.
